notes: PDF-only review: this paper studies six young B-type stars in the outskirts of the LMC. Stars 390 and 403 are described as escaping the LMC and as runaways from the inner LMC (Sec. 2, pp. 4-5; Summary), not as Milky Way-unbound HVS candidates. The Milky Way orbit check addresses whether these stars originated in our Galaxy, and the paper rejects that origin; it does not claim Galactic unbound status. HVS3 is cited only as an analogy for Magellanic origin. No object is treated as possibly unbound from the Milky Way under the benchmark definition.
